_comment: CoreSkeleton27 (ARDY) -> Red Valley production skeleton. Committed as data, not inferred by string matching (docs/SKELETON_SPEC.md). Verified against ardy/skeleton/definitions.py::CoreSkeleton27 and art/animation/ardy_pilot/rig/rv_rig.json.

target_unmapped.root: Intentional. Our root is a ground-plane reference that never animates. ARDY's world displacement lives on Hips; it is stripped here and handed to code as forward speed (the in-place conversion).
target_unmapped.prop_socket.R: Non-deforming attachment point. Follows hand.R; never receives motion data.

source_unmapped.Spine: Spine chain compresses 4 -> 2. See spine_compression below.
source_unmapped.Spine2: Spine chain compresses 4 -> 2. See spine_compression below.
source_unmapped.RightHandThumb1: We have no finger bones by spec; dropped.
source_unmapped.LeftHandThumb1: We have no finger bones by spec; dropped.
source_unmapped.RightHandEnd: Leaf//end joint, no target bone; used only for hand orientation if needed.
source_unmapped.LeftHandEnd: Leaf/end joint, no target bone; used only for hand orientation if needed.

spine_compression.problem: ARDY has Spine, Spine1, Spine2, Spine3 (4 joints); we have spine, chest (2). Dropping the extra two would silently discard torso bend.
spine_compression.rule: COMPOSE, do not drop. target.spine receives Spine * Spine1; target.chest receives Spine2 * Spine3, both as accumulated local rotations along the chain.
spine_compression.status: MUST be implemented in the retarget step; naive name-matching would lose it.

export_artifact.neutral_bone: Blender's glTF exporter injects this because prop_socket.R is non-deforming. It carries no animation; the retarget must ignore it rather than treat it as a joint.

_source_order_note: Authoritative index order, read from ardy.skeleton.definitions.CoreSkeleton27 and committed as data so the retarget never has to import torch.
